message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 79.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and Business process analyst. I want to become a Portal Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 2400 per year. I live in Coimbatore. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This MBA Technology Management program in Delhi has the highest median starting salary ($17361) and a strong placement rate (90%), directly addressing your priority of securing a good job. The minimum required grade (79%) is slightly higher than your current average (79.8%), but its focus on IT management aligns well with your interest in becoming a Portal Administrator.

Located in Pune, this MTech Computer Networks program offers strong technical skills (networking/cloud) and boasts a high median starting salary ($15192). Since you have an information security background and are interested in programming, the networking focus is highly relevant for roles like Portal Administrator.

This MBA Technology Management program in Hyderabad provides a good balance of career focus and cost. It has a high median starting salary ($15400) and is less demanding academically than some options, making it an excellent choice for someone prioritizing job outcomes while keeping costs low.

The MSc Human-Computer Interaction program in Coimbatore is geographically convenient and aligns with your interest in business process analysis. It offers a solid placement rate (85%) and a manageable tuition fee ($2250), making it a strong local option focused on user experience for portals.

This PG Diploma in Systems Administration in Pune is highly specialized and directly relates to the role of a Portal Administrator. While its median salary ($12687) is lower than top picks, it offers excellent placement (87%) and low tuition costs, making it a practical choice for job readiness.
